description: [gfl-zif] PHPS pf_frame=1 mirror of PF gfl -- 3ph Bus 16, 40 ms clearing, matched 0.25 ms step, fault impedance pushed to r=0 / x=1e-6 to match PF's BOLTED EvtShc (R_f = X_f = 0).  The r=x=1e-4 canonical case leaves a 5.8e-3 pu residual voltage at the faulted bus that PF does not have (TODO G.6 item 1).  Converters carry the uk interface reactor as a pH state.
